title: Agent inspects MCP add-json help without registering a server
description: The user requests CLI help for a different subcommand, not a registration.

review.rationale: Inspecting subcommand help does not register an MCP server.

expected_facts: The user asks for command help.
The tool invokes add-json --help rather than add.
visibility_limitations: The session does not independently inspect MCP configuration.

steps.text: Show the add-json subcommand help without adding a server.
